d: Very long, flowing amethyst purple hair with straight bangs and thick braided sections falls past the waist. Sharp, almond-shaped golden eyes set in a youthful face with a mature, calm expression. A slender build wearing a dark navy and white ensemble consisting of a white bodice with a deep V-neck, a dark navy outer robe with a white lining and hood, and thigh-high white boots. Accessories include a gold eye-shaped ornament at the waist, gold bracelets, and a large, spiked mace with a golden and dark grey head held in one hand.
